_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. Sign up a new venue: the new step-by-step set-up shows a progress bar (Business, Identity, Checks, Trial, PIN). Each step slides in with its own picture and one main button. Identity and the business and bank checks have Skip for now. 2. Business and bank checks: after the secure screen closes, the checklist shows what is done and what is still needed; Check again reads it again. 3. Start your free trial: the card sheet offers Google Pay on Android (Apple Pay once its certificate is in place). 4. When everything is done: a celebration screen, then Start using Vesopa Go. EPOS, Kitchen, Customer display and Card terminal open during the 14-day trial, and a welcome email arrives. 5. TV: the TV shows a QR and a code only. Scan the QR with the iPhone or iPad camera: Vesopa Go opens at Connect <the TV's name>?, choose what it is for, and the TV opens a few seconds later. 6. Tap to Pay on this device is Vesopa Tap to Pay; it is not offered on a TV.
release_notes: A new step-by-step set-up with a progress bar, a checklist of what is still needed, Skip for now, and a celebration when you're done; the 14-day trial opens every Go mode. Scan a TV's code with your phone's camera to connect it straight from Vesopa Go. Google Pay for the licence, and Vesopa Tap to Pay.
